short: Natural Kare & Wellness provides personalized clinical nutrition, and wellness support to help individuals make healthier, sustainable lifestyle changes. I focus on nutrition, education, healthy, weight management, gut health, women’s wellness, emotional eating, and disease prevention through practical nutrition and lifestyle strategies.
training:
M. S. in Applied Clinical Nutrition-Northeast College of Health Sciences (2024)
 B.S. in Health Education and Health Promotion-Arizona State University ( 2020)

Additional training: motivational interviewing, clinical nutrition, medical nutrition, therapy, concepts, and supervise clinical practices/Capestone experience.
integrative: My graduate education and Applied Clinical Nutrition including coursework in clinical nutrition and exposure to integrative and functional nutrition approaches, including nutrition- focused case studies and evidence-informed strategies for supporting overall health and wellness.
pricing:
* Initial consultation: 60 minutes- $50
* Follow up session: 45 minutes -$40
* 3-session package: $125
* 5- session package: $200
long: Natural Kare & Wellness was created to make nutrition feel more practical, approachable, and realistic for everyday life. I work with individuals to better understand their relationship with food, develop healthier habits, and feel more confident making choices that support their overall well-being.
size: “My goal is to build a sustainable practice serving approximately 10-15 clients per week, with availability 3-5 days per week. I would like to gradually grow my client base while maintaining personalized, high-quality support for each individual.”
